bounds: Nine finite static state scenes; no implementation or live-operation claims. Each state is a separately marked fictional branch unless explicitly a later snapshot of the same run.

states.title: 第一页：多客户工作表与完整选中范围
states.purpose: 证明已选方案3支持超过三位客户，不把可见行误当全部。
states.prompt: Render the selected W02 worksheet layout with eighteen fictional eligible customers in the pending collection, not eighteen horizontal columns. Show only the first three familiar rows: Jamie Chen, Taylor Brooks, and Jordan Lee, keeping their established processing and transit values. Display “已选 18 位客户 · 当前显示 1–3” and visible pagination or scrolling affordances. Do not invent existing sites for the hidden fifteen customers; they are merely additional fictional unbuilt examples in this design scenario. Keep the independent read-only summary below the worksheet explicitly labelled for Jamie. The footer still targets all eighteen selected customers and says “尚未提交”. State that switching pages preserves each customer’s input. A visible selection-count explanation distinguishes search results from the complete collection. Step one remains active, with “取消” and “下一步：站点配置”, never a start button. No shared company fields, automatic copying of personal data, or client-creation shortcut appears. The visible processing ranges are 2–4, 1–3, and 2–5 working days; transit ranges are 5–10, 4–8, and 5–12. Preserve each company name and Jamie’s existing contact details. Display a clear selected-row treatment, but never let the currently inspected customer become the only selected customer or replace the complete pending collection. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards.
required_content: 分页/筛选不改变完整集合

states.title: 第三页：长清单与固定全局启动范围
states.purpose: 确认选中方案1在客户多时仍启动完整集合，不只提交当前可见客户。
states.prompt: Render W04 using the selected vertical manifest and fixed confirmation sidebar. The pending collection contains eighteen customers, while the viewport displays Jamie, Taylor, and Jordan with their established companies, domains, mailboxes, and configuration values. A quiet line states “完整清单 18 项 · 当前显示 3 项”; the sidebar clearly reads “本次启动：18 位客户 · 18 个网站”. Keep a scroll affordance on the manifest and a stable sidebar rather than compressing everyone into horizontal comparison columns. Explain “底部操作提交完整清单，不仅是当前可见项。” The global acknowledgement is checked and the button reads “确认并开始建站（18）”. Preserve the cost notice, maintenance mode, manual publication boundary, and gateway distinction. Step three is active, and “当前尚未提交建站” remains visible. Do not show success, omit hidden customers silently, or imply that filtering the list changes who will be submitted. Preserve the visible three companies and their corresponding mailboxes exactly. The fixed sidebar must remain readable without competing with the website list. Scrolling should be suggested as a viewing action, not a new batch-creation operation. Keep each row’s edit link scoped to that customer, while the single global confirmation applies to the whole collection. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards.
required_content: 当前可见3项不改变全局数量

states.title: 资源读取失败
states.purpose: 分别呈现域名读取失败与邮箱读取失败，不能假装无资源或已验证。
states.prompt: Create a W03 configuration failure state while retaining all three pending customer rows. Jamie’s domain selector shows “域名资源读取失败”, with “重试读取” and a concise network-error explanation; do not label the domain inventory empty. Taylor retains paperfield.example but the mailbox control shows “邮箱读取失败，尚未核验”, again with a targeted retry. Jordan’s existing entered values remain intact and are not reset because other rows failed. Keep previous values visible where appropriate with a clear “待重新核验” label rather than presenting them as verified available resources. The page summary identifies two unresolved resource checks and says nothing has been submitted. “上一步” remains available; “下一步：确认启动” is disabled until required resource checks can be satisfied or an explicit customer item is removed. Do not start a website, automatically buy a domain, create a mailbox, or infer an empty account from a transport failure. Retain the existing brand, category, quantity, and optional price values under each affected customer. Use a short factual error label rather than a speculative account or provider diagnosis. Resource availability is unverified, not permanently invalid. Any saved choice shown in the row should be visually distinguished from a newly verified option. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards.
required_content: Taylor所选域名正确但邮箱读取失败
重试读取，不显示开通成功

states.title: 读取成功但无可用资源
states.purpose: 与读取失败明确区分，指向现有资源处理入口而不虚构购买/开通能力。
states.prompt: Create a separate W03 resource-empty example, not a retry-error screen. Jamie’s domain is cedar-living.example, and the mailbox query has completed successfully but found no usable mailbox. Show “读取完成：该域名下暂无可用邮箱” with an existing-resource or hPanel guidance link; do not show an invented inline mailbox purchase success. Taylor’s domain area explicitly states “读取完成：暂无可用域名”, with an account-and-domain resource entry. Keep Jordan’s entered configuration unchanged. Use neutral informational styling rather than making every empty resource a red server failure. The table continues to identify each customer and company independently. Explain that returning from resource preparation should preserve this unsent selection and allow an explicit refresh. Required resource absence prevents moving into the final ready-to-start state, but it does not delete customer records or reject a gateway application. Keep “上一步” and a disabled “下一步：确认启动”, with no automatic provisioning, payment, or silent removal of either customer. Show an explicit completed-query status near each neutral empty selector so users cannot confuse this branch with a connection failure. Keep the three-company mapping visible and preserve other entered fields. Links point to existing resource handling rather than inventing purchases inside the wizard. Returning to this screen does not automatically submit pending websites. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards.
required_content: 读取成功与无资源同时明确
Jamie所选域名下无已开通邮箱
前往现有资源/开通入口

states.title: 建站提交结果未知
states.purpose: 在外部/服务器结果不确定时先核验，不重复创建网站或宣称失败。
states.prompt: Render the selected W04 manifest with the original three customers and their unchanged final values. Replace the normal ready confirmation state with a clear banner “提交结果未知”. Explain “请求已发出，但暂未收到明确结果；先核验已有记录，避免重复建站。” Do not invent a successful batch identifier or say that every request failed. Keep the complete collection visible, with the sidebar labelled as a submitted request whose result still needs checking, not a newly editable empty draft. Disable or remove the repeat-start action and provide a focused “核验提交结果” button. A secondary “查看已有任务” entry may lead to actual records without claiming that they already exist. Preserve all configuration locally in the design intent. Avoid a green success badge, an automatic retry countdown, duplicate website creation, or a blind button labelled “再次提交”. This is an uncertainty-handling design state, not evidence that the real backend already implements reconciliation. Keep the original request scope of three websites visible independently from the outcome of any single row. A lost response does not justify resetting successful work or clearing the batch selection. Do not add a guessed error code, provider explanation, or successful completion time. Mark this as an independent uncertain-submission scenario. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards.
required_content: 结果未知不是失败/成功
已发起请求，暂未确认结果
不得凭空分配成功批次号

states.title: 上线前QA读取失败
states.purpose: QA读取失败不得当作零问题或允许上线。
states.prompt: Show the “上线前网站复核” modal for Casey Parker, Meadow Home LLC, meadow-home.example, still “建成 · 维护中”. This branch differs from the successful-report O-W05 scene: the latest QA request has failed, and there is no current report available to support publication. Display “最新复核结果读取失败” and “尚未取得结果，不能按无问题处理”. Keep any old report reference visually secondary and explicitly stale; it must not unlock publication. The main available action is “重新读取”, with “取消” beside it. If “上线” remains visible, it is disabled with a concise reason. Do not offer “仍然上线” after a failed report read, because the existing workflow only permits acknowledging actual unresolved findings after reading a report. Do not substitute Alex’s published website or his Q-001 through Q-003 findings. No resource or customer state changes, and no success notification appears. Use the corrected Casey overlay as the object and history reference: original batch B20261012-01 belongs to 陈佳, while the current login and new read attempt belong to 李敏. This independent failure occurs after the earlier report. Preserve original task attribution and maintenance status; do not rewrite the historical batch as the current review operation. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards.
required_content: 未取得结果，不显示0问题

states.title: 恢复被后续修改阻止
states.purpose: 真实后置变更冲突阻止旧记录恢复，不提供强制成功。
states.prompt: Render a recovery-conflict dialog for Alex Morgan’s northline.example. The requested target is the older CHG-013, “调整首页介绍文案”, from “10/16/2026 16:20 PT”. A later applied record exists: CHG-014, “首页标题修改为 Northline Goods”, at “10/17/2026 13:10 PT”. Display both records with their distinct operators and times, without pretending that they are the same field or rewriting their history. The warning says “存在后续网站修改，不能直接恢复此记录”. Explain that the current site and both change records remain intact while the conflict is reviewed. The primary action is “查看后续变更”; provide “返回” or “关闭” as an exit. Do not display an enabled force-restore button or a fabricated fully restored result. Keep the published website state independent from this recovery failure. Nothing here changes customer data, gateway snapshots, domain renewal, or mailbox resources. The historical CHG-013 operator is 陈佳; CHG-014 was initiated by 李敏 and executed by AI. The current dialog is opened by 李敏. Keep all three attribution roles distinct. Use the corrected W11 reference, not the obsolete version. A visible disabled recovery control may explain the conflict without offering a workaround. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards. Preserve every customer attachment unchanged.
required_content: 查看后续变更/返回，无强制恢复

states.title: 修复部分成功及人工项保留
states.purpose: 修复成功、执行失败、人工处理三类并存，计数守恒。
states.prompt: Create a completed mixed-result repair panel for the later northline.example QA run. Keep Q-001 “联系页面排版溢出” as “已修复 · 待复核”, Q-002 “页脚缺少退换货政策入口” as “修复失败”, and Q-003 “商品图片需人工核对” as “需人工处理”. The counts must be exactly one completed automatic action, one failed automatic action, and one manual item. A readable failure explanation can say the requested website modification could not be completed; do not invent a provider-specific root cause. Provide a targeted “重试此项” for Q-002, “查看结果” for Q-001, and “查看详情” for Q-003. The footer may offer “查看当前报告” and “关闭”. Never describe the whole report as passed, discard Q-001 because Q-002 failed, or count the manual item as automatically resolved. Successful execution still needs review evidence before claiming the issue is gone. Continue the same fictional run R-20261017-001 that began at 13:35 PT, now showing a later result rather than a second hidden repair attempt. 李敏 remains the initiator. Keep the underlying site published. The original 13:30 report remains the source snapshot; repair outcomes do not retroactively rewrite that earlier report. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards. Only retry the failed automatic item after explicit confirmation.
required_content: 只重试失败项，不清除已完成结果

states.title: 交易测试邮件发送结果未知
states.purpose: 避免把未确认受理当成功或自动重复发送。
states.prompt: Show the transactional-test-email dialog after an uncertain send attempt for northline.example. Retain the sender hello@northline.example, recipient qa-inbox@example.com, and subject “网站交易邮件测试（DEMO）” as read-only facts. A neutral warning states “发送结果未知” and explains that a definitive SMTP acceptance result was not received. It must not say the recipient received the message, nor must it automatically label the operation a confirmed failure. Replace the normal send button with “核验发送结果”; a secondary close action does not retract any email that might already have been accepted. Disable immediate duplicate sending until the prior attempt has been checked. Keep the operator and attempted time visible using American date format and PT. Do not attach customer documents, initiate a payment, contact a gateway, reset mailbox credentials, or change website publication status. This mockup demonstrates uncertainty handling only; it is not a real delivery or provider test. Use Alex Morgan and Northline LLC consistently with the corrected website-mail reference. 李敏 is the initiator, and no previous task operator is replaced. Show the attempted time as 10/17/2026 13:50 PT. Leave the original website and mailbox configuration unchanged while the result is checked; uncertainty is not permission for an automatic resend. Use the existing white and dark navy shell, readable Chinese labels, subtle borders, small corner radii, and no decorative dashboards.
required_content: 结果未知，不显示已送达
无自动再次发送/无付款
